name: deepseek-harness
description: DeepSeek harness: connect to remote Linux hosts over SSH and open remote directories as agent workspaces (run commands, read/write files, search, upload/download).

interface.shortDescription: SSH remote workspace harness for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Turns a remote Linux VM into an agent workspace over SSH. Provides tools to connect (password, private key, or ssh-agent), open a remote directory as the current workspace, run commands, read/write/edit files, glob/grep the remote tree, and upload/download between the local machine and the remote workspace.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Linux VM over SSH and open /srv/app as the workspace, then show the top-level files.
